At H the first barrier is the old radius, the second is no smaller, and the right slope of their minimum is at most −D. The joined profile is positive and concave with nonpositive slopes, including H=m and a flat barrier.

Reflection of the outward drops, followed by the constant central link between bases 0 and 1, gives a concave interpolated radius and a positive actual convex simplex subgraph. Every modified pair remains uncaptured, and each enlarged positive radius increases or preserves its area.
